articles.title: China’s ‘electric eel’ sensor allows robots to feel an object without touching it
articles.summary: Chinese scientists have developed an innovative 'electric eel' sensor that enables robots to detect and analyze objects without physical contact, mimicking the natural radar used by electric eels in murky waters. This breakthrough could revolutionize robotics by enhancing object recognition and interaction capabilities, paving the way for safer and more efficient automation in various environments.

articles.title: Global leaders must wake up to threat of unbridled AI adoption
articles.summary: The article warns that the unchecked adoption of artificial intelligence poses a grave risk, highlighting the urgent need for responsible leadership to navigate its potential benefits and dangers, particularly in Western nations. This critical juncture could determine whether AI serves as a catalyst for global prosperity or a source of unprecedented challenges.
